verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You are the source of life
I can't be left behind

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
No one else will do
I will take hold of You

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Cause I need You Jesus to come to my rescue
Where else can I go

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
There's no other name by which I am saved
Capture me with grace
I will follow You

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
My heart is Yours for life
I need Your hand in mine

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
No one else will do
Lord, I put my trust in You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: This world has nothing for me (I will follow You) x4
